trello.name: Renew and deploy wildcard SSL certificates
trello.desc: Ben is responsible for renewing and deploying the wildcard SSL certificate for api.ourapp.com before August 22nd to allow a buffer before the September 1st expiration. He must also set up auto-renewal using cert-manager and rotate the internal CA certificate for the service mesh, which expires two weeks after the public cert. Both certificates should be handled in the same maintenance window.

trello.name: Implement PDF export feature for reports
trello.desc: Aisha will develop the PDF export feature for reports by the end of the month. This includes backend rendering of reports to PDF using headless Chrome, frontend addition of the export button with a progress state, and creating a short demo GIF for marketing to use in the changelog. The task covers both backend and frontend deliverables as a single unit.

trello.name: Ensure staging environment parity with production
trello.desc: Ben will address staging environment drift by running the three pending migrations today and writing a nightly job to compare the staging schema against production. The job will post alerts to the infra channel if differences are detected, ensuring staging remains aligned with production.
